name: Power Users
audience: 每天都用、有多个账号的重度用户

promotionalText.zh-Hans: 多个账号、不同服务器，长按「我」即可切换。主题色、帖子字号、深浅色随你调，个人资料一页改好。为每天都在长毛象上的你而做。
promotionalText.en-US: Several accounts on different servers? Long-press Me to switch. Pick a theme color, tune the post text size, go light or dark, and edit your whole profile on one page.
